meta.description: 流年/流月飛星、太歲三煞、立春與節氣天文演算、干支、九運 測試向量

conventions.cstFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm' in UTC+8 (HKT = Taipei = Beijing standard time), rounded to nearest minute like HKO/CWA/PMO
conventions.bearing: degrees clockwise from true north; 子=0, 卯=90, 午=180, 酉=270; 24 shan are 15 deg wide
conventions.flightOrder: Luoshu forward: 中宮 -> 西北 -> 西 -> 東北 -> 南 -> 北 -> 西南 -> 東 -> 東南 (star = center + k, wrap 1..9)
conventions.yearBoundary: exact 立春 instant (apparent solar longitude 315 deg)
conventions.monthBoundary: exact 節 instants (小寒/立春/驚蟄/...); month order 0=寅月 ... 11=丑月
conventions.monthlyCenterFormula: first(寅月)= 8 for 子午卯酉年, 5 for 辰戌丑未年, 2 for 寅申巳亥年; then -1 per month (wrap 1..9)
conventions.yunFormula: d=(Y-1864) mod 180 ; yun=floor(d/20)+1 ; yunYear=(d mod 20)+1 ; yuan = 上(<60) 中(<120) 下

tolerances.solar_term_time: toleranceMinutes on each case (official tables are rounded to the minute; reference implementation error <= 0.8 min for 1900-2049)

solar_longitude_at_instant.expected: apparentLongitudeDeg of the Sun at termInstant(year, termIndex)

monthly_flying_star.expected: fengshuiYear, jie, monthGanzhi, monthOrder, monthlyCenter (+ startCST/endCST/monthlyChart when present)

taisui_sansha.expected: 太歲/歲破 branch+bearing, 三煞 mountains/dir, 三煞弧 sanshaArcCore3(三個 15° 山)與 sanshaArcWithJiaSha(含夾煞 75°), 夾煞

taisui_sansha_year.expected: ganzhi, taisui, suipo, sansha, sanshaDir, jiaSha (+wuhuang)

monthly_flying_star_b2.expected: fengshuiYear, yearGanzhi, monthGanzhi, monthOrder, monthlyCenter(B.2 補案: 辰戌丑未年起始 5 組與 1 月丑月)

month_pillar_five_tigers_b2.expected: fengshuiYear, yearGanzhi, monthGanzhi(B.2 補案: 五虎遁五個年干組的寅月月柱)

referenceImplementation.language: javascript (UMD, ES2015, no dependencies; CommonJS module.exports or window.FengshuiAnnual)
referenceImplementation.api: termInstant(year,i) formatCST(ms) lichun(year) fengshuiYear(ms) monthOf(ms) monthTable(fy) annualCenter(fy) monthlyCenter(yearBranch,order) fly(center) palaceOfStar(center,star) nineYun(fy) taisui(branchIdx) sansha(branchIdx) analyze(ms)
referenceImplementation.note: Solar longitude: VSOP87D Earth truncated to 37 terms (A*0.1^k >= 1e-6 rad) + 4-term nutation + aberration (-20.4898 arcsec / R) + Espenak-Meeus DeltaT, Newton root solve. Supports 1900-2100. All cases in this file pass against it.

testRunner.usage: extract the two 'source' strings of this meta into files, then: node run_fixtures.mjs annual.json ./fengshui-annual.js

reproduction: curl https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api with COMMAND='10' CENTER='500@399' EPHEM_TYPE='OBSERVER' QUANTITIES='31' TLIST_TYPE='JD' TIME_TYPE='UT' ANG_FORMAT='DEG' CSV_FORMAT='YES' TLIST='<JD_UT list>'  (DE441 apparent longitude; root-solve to (285+15i) deg)
